title: Issue and pull request triage
description: Label GitHub issues or pull requests by kind and severity, detect duplicates, or filter AI review comments

kind.instructions: What kind of issue is this? Judge only the reporter's own content.

criteria.bug: Something that used to work, or should work, is broken or crashes
criteria.feature: A request for new behaviour or an enhancement
criteria.question: A usage or how-to question with no defect claimed
criteria.docs: A problem or gap in documentation only

severity.instructions: How severe is the impact described?
criteria: Cosmetic or negligible; no functional impact
Moderate; a feature is degraded for some users
Major; a core feature is broken for many users
Critical; total outage, data loss, or exposure of other people's private data (security breach)

urgent.instructions: Does this issue need attention within a day?

criteria.true: Needs attention within a day: production is down or data/security at risk
criteria.false: Can wait for normal backlog grooming

actionable.instructions: Does this issue say enough for a maintainer to start work?

criteria.true: The issue states what was done, what was expected and what happened, enough for a maintainer to start work
criteria.false: The issue is too vague to act on; the maintainer must ask the reporter for more information

combine: needs_info if actionable <= needs_info_at; unsure if kind.p < label_p; label otherwise

urgency.combine: escalate if urgent >= urgent_escalate; human if urgent >= urgent_human; normal otherwise

limitations: sees only the state (a claimed regression needs the diff in state)
a backlog is a batch job over the same questions, one row per issue
the label is signals.kind; severity is signals.severity
notes: # deviation: spec 5.7: `actionable` is asked with the other three (the spec case asks it alone), with the lint-style instruction the spec says the linter adds for `urgent`; urgent >= 0.85 / 0.3-0.85 is the `urgency` output (escalate, human, normal), not a decision; the label itself is the kind signal
